reader.decision: Approve the grace period change to 90s now. Approve late ack with prefetch only on condition that Billing confirms meter.internal dedupes on `ref` (or we add a dedupe guard). If Billing says it cannot dedupe, ship the grace period alone.
reader.decision_reason: The message shows the grace period (20s) is shorter than both the drain (60s) and video jobs (up to 70s), so raising it is safe and clearly needed. Late ack fixes the root cause but can double-bill, and the message says dedupe on meter.internal is unverified, so that part depends on Billing's answer.

reconstruction.problem: After a deploy, a few uploads get no thumbnail and no error. The worker acks every job on delivery (auto_ack=True, no prefetch limit), feeds a 4-thread pool, and keeps starting queued jobs after SIGTERM. The pod gets SIGKILL after 20s, while DRAIN_SECONDS is 60 and video jobs take 25 to 70s.
reconstruction.what_breaks: Running jobs (u-88217, u-88218, u-88219, u-88221) and any jobs waiting in the pool queue are killed at 14:02:30. They never log 'job done' and no error is logged. RabbitMQ already considers them acked, so it will not redeliver them, and the upload page shows the placeholder forever. Crashes, OOM kills and node loss lose jobs the same way.
reconstruction.fix: Preferred: set auto_ack=False, add basic_qos(prefetch_count=settings.CONCURRENCY), ack after handle returns via connection.add_callback_threadsafe with delivery_tag, nack with requeue on exception, and raise terminationGracePeriodSeconds from 20 to 90. Alternative: change only the grace period to 90 and keep auto_ack=True.
reconstruction.cost: Late ack gives at-least-once delivery, so a job can run twice. A kill after record_usage but before the ack could bill an upload twice. put_thumbnail is idempotent because its key is fixed. Whether meter.internal dedupes on `ref` is not known, because Billing owns it. Grace-period-only costs one line and adds no double-billing risk, but still silently drops jobs on crash, OOM or node loss.

follow_up_questions: Does meter.internal dedupe on `ref`, according to the Billing team?
If it does not dedupe, is double billing of an upload unacceptable, or could we add our own idempotency guard before record_usage?
reader.closing_answer: I approve the 90s grace period now. I approve late ack with prefetch only once Billing confirms meter.internal dedupes on `ref`, or we add a dedupe guard before record_usage. If Billing says it cannot dedupe and double billing is unacceptable, ship only the grace period change. I ask Billing about the dedupe on `ref` first.
